audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names 'Headbutt' as matchup-defining but gives no real cooldown number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Headbutt (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s CD and Trample (E) auto-attack-reset stun is on a 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cycle — both from ownerKit/enemyKit — and missingInteractions flags the Trample auto-reset tell as unaddressed anywhere in the page.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries both real numbers and the auto-reset tell; the two copy-pasted bullets were rewritten to say something distinct from tradeGood/tradeBad under their own titles.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - E-Q stun package is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Alistar Headbutt (W): 14/13/12/11/10s CD — down means zero engage, that is your window. - Trample (E) auto-resets his auto for burst; the wind-up is your cue to back off. - W-Q stun saves fights, not trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Ablaze with W first, then Q — a stun fired before the burn ticks whiffs the moment he is not already lit.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Headbutt (14/13/12/11/10s CD) down means zero engage — that is your all-in window, not a poke one.

notes: Triumphant Roar (P) sustain is already covered generically via report[8].t's anti-heal itemization line; left as-is since it isn't a template and adding a Alistar-specific antiheal callout would need a new field slot.
